narrative: The end plot of the burned row. Four bays of green oak, almost yellow, lying on the ground, not yet raised. Charred wattle, a chimney standing, weeds in the ash. No one is in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once, and did not stay.

entities.name: the cousin's frame
entities.context: In photo: The four bays of green oak at the end plot
